<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LegoMachine" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LegoMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Machine build started"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Build_Merge" name="Ready to build"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Parts_Split" name="Parts available in container?" default="Flow_NoParts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Test_Split" name="Test successful?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" name="Assemble subcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Built" name="Machine built"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="Gateway_Build_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Build_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Parts_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Parts_Split" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoParts" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Parts_Split" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_Build_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_Test_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Test_Split" targetRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Test_Split" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_Build_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" targetRef="EndEvent_Built"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
